cost.caveats: Resource estimate only; excludes staging, build, storage, expiry controller, cleanup, egress and excess CPU/RAM usage. Monthly provider budgets include prior usage; environment compute budgets differ from workspace coverage. Recheck prices and verify operator allowance before paid approval. Credits are separate from gross cost.

provenance.access: Public, private=false, gated=false; tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json, config.json and LICENSE listed at pinned commit. No weights downloaded or account credentials inspected.
provenance.license_prerequisites: Preserve Apache-2.0 license, attribution and applicable notices on redistribution; review pinned model card and applicable usage obligations before execution.
provenance.compatibility: Released linux/amd64 image; primary vLLM recipe documents single-A100 GPT-OSS using Triton attention and Marlin MXFP4. Isolated tooling requires Python 3.12 to match the remote images. CPU-only bootstrap on 2026-11-06 observed Python 3.12.13, vLLM 0.17.0 and typing_extensions 4.12.2 lacking Sentinel, preventing pydantic_core import. The serving recipe clears the inherited vLLM entrypoint and pins typing_extensions==4.16.0 before deferred source files; CPU import validation is required before GPU execution. Hardware fit, model readiness and actual logprob alignment remain unverified.
